title: Relay
summary: Support desk with SLA timers, an email-to-ticket webhook and a lead dashboard.
description: Customers open tickets and rate the help they got; agents work an inbox with SLA chips and internal notes; a lead watches the numbers. An inbound webhook turns email into tickets and an escalation runs every 15 minutes.
roles_summary: Customers sign up. Agents work the queue. A lead watches the numbers.
includes: Customer portal with ticket threads and ratings
